[HIGH] INV-099 is marked received but its delivery date is in the future

INV-099 (ALDER WHOLESALE LLC, $146.00) is marked 'received' with delivery date 2026-10-06, which is after today (2026-10-05). It carries 40 lb of Chicken thigh boneless skinless. Counting it as on hand, the 2026-10-04 close is 45.0 lb below expected (92.9 expected vs 47.9 counted); not counting it, the gap is 5.0 lb. What was counted covers about 2.0 days at last week's theoretical use of 24.4 lb/day.

Evidence:
  - invoice_headers.csv SITE-01 INV-099 rev1: status received, delivery 2026-10-06, invoice 2026-10-04
  - invoice_lines.csv SITE-01 INV-099-L01 rev1: 40 lb Chicken thigh 20 lb
  - notes.csv SITE-01 N15 rev1: …Office marked the next chicken order received but I have not seen the cases.
  - inventory_counts.csv SITE-01 COUNT-OPEN-CHICKEN rev1: opening 32 lb
  - inventory_counts.csv SITE-01 COUNT-CLOSE-CHICKEN rev1: closing 47.9 lb
  - notes.csv SITE-01 N06 rev1: …felt warm at open. Moved what we could, tossed an unweighed tray of chicken and a tub of cut peppers. Service…

Uncertain:
  - Receipt status is typed in by the office, not scanned at the door, so the status alone does not show the cases arrived.
  - Theoretical use assumes recipe cards were followed; there are no intermediate counts or waste records to confirm it.
  - Weekend special (M99) sold 32 portions with no recipe on file, so some chicken draw is unmeasured.
  - Note N06 (2026-09-22) records chicken discarded without weighing.

Next step: The manager confirmed the cases are not here. Confirm with Alder Wholesale whether INV-099 has shipped before placing the next order. Until confirmed, plan with Chicken thigh boneless skinless at 47.9 lb on hand, about 2.0 days.
